name: Daylight Lattice
tagline: A title card in daylight: one grotesk at cinema scale over a living lattice of minutes.
summary: Albretsen AS is shown as a lattice of products and minutes, with each square lit by real activity. The name is set like the opening title of a film, in warm daylight and pastel mint, so the ambition reads as big while the tone stays calm and generous. The mark is an A made from the busiest cells of that lattice, so the logo and the live data share one language.
voice: Warm and witty, with no swagger: it states facts and then smiles. Example: "Four in play. Seven retired with honours."
motion: Everything moves on damped springs: cells pop when an event lands, the lattice glides one minute left with inertia, and links lean in and settle.
sound: Off until asked. Switching it on plays "A in daylight", an A-major arpeggio strummed upward that lands on the octave over a soft A bed, after which each event gives a quiet pitched tick.
mark: A 5x5 lattice in which the hottest cells spell the letter A. It doubles as the favicon, and each cell answers a different product live.
